title: StarBeam
description: Zoey is excited to tackle second grade, but when danger beckons, she sneaks away and with her signature call out and transforms into StarBeam, the speediest, most powerful and most enthusiastic superhero to ever sip from a juicebox.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x1
episodes_data.description: The greedy Captain Fishbeard is on a mission to steal a shiny bell from City Hall. But Zoey knows you shouldn't take things that don't belong to you.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x2
episodes_data.description: There's an uninvited guest at Gramps's surprise birthday party: the sneaky, shape-shifting villain Goop! Can Zoey and her mom team up to get rid of him?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x3
episodes_data.description: It's StarBeam to the rescue when Miserable Marla sends a hair-raising static electricity storm to school to ruin class picture day.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x4
episodes_data.description: StarBeam zooms into space to save a famous astronaut when a meteor shower damages her shuttle and sends it spinning toward the moon.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x5
episodes_data.description: Henry invents shoes to help Zoey with her dancing until she can master the moves on her own. But when it's time for her recital, they won't come off!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x6
episodes_data.description: When Captain Fishbeard steals the Jewel of Fire from Lava Lava Island, the island itself attacks him — and now he needs StarBeam's help!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x7
episodes_data.description: It's Zoey's turn to bring Quincy, the class caterpillar, home and keep him safe. But her plans change when he turns into a butterfly!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 1x8
episodes_data.description: Zoey's mom comes down with a case of the Super Sniffles, throwing her powers all out of whack. Can StarBeam save the day and convince her to rest?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x1
episodes_data.description: When mischievous Murps try to snatch a mysterious blue meteorite from the museum, StarBeam swoops in and learns why they're so desperate to snag it.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x2
episodes_data.description: Zoey’s classmate Stella is StarBeam’s biggest fan. Will her favorite superhero save her when super-strong Cosmic Crusher suddenly shows up at school?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x3
episodes_data.description: Bleep Blop, the vacuuming robot, is great for clean-up time. But StarBeam must stop Henry's new gizmo when a glitch makes it suck up everything in sight!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x4
episodes_data.description: To make sure all the moms get fresh flowers on Mother’s Day, StarBeam will need to stop Miserable Marla from bringing lots of rain to ruin their plans.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x5
episodes_data.description: It's time to shine ... under the sea! StarBeam dives deep down into the ocean to save a worried baby whale whose tail gets all tangled up in a net.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x6
episodes_data.description: When all the town’s fish sticks suddenly disappear, it’s up to StarBeam to teach selfish Captain Fishbeard that it always pays to be polite and share.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x7
episodes_data.description: Snails are too slimy and gooey for Zoey! But can she learn to like them when the aquarium needs StarBeam’s help to search for its lost sea snail?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 2x8
episodes_data.description: Greta and Gunther are at the lighthouse for a playdate. But when shifty Goop slinks into town, StarBeam needs to shield her twin friends from trouble.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x1
episodes_data.description: When baddies Todd and Goop team up to ruin Somerset’s spring Eggstravaganza, StarBeam is out to stop them with some help — all while hunting for eggs!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x2
episodes_data.description: A pesky pixie keeps switching up the hiking trail signs during a camping trip! Can StarBeam and Boost put a pause on all of her perilous pranks?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x3
episodes_data.description: With a roar louder than a lion’s, the Isle of Brrr's legendary beast faces off with StarBeam after she spots him taking a snow bunny back to his cave.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x4
episodes_data.description: Goop gets his slippery hands on the mighty Beam Key after sneaking into Zoey’s school. Can StarBeam show up to snatch it back before anyone notices?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x5
episodes_data.description: Fishbeard and StarBeam on the same team? They'll have to work together to find a treasure and rescue their pets trapped in a cave on Lava Lava Island.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x6
episodes_data.description: Tricksy the pixie is back with her pranks to ruin Wheels Day, but Boost has just the thing to help StarBeam put the brakes on all of the trouble.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x7
episodes_data.description: Cosmic Crusher is causing chaos at the carnival games on Loop-de-Loop Island. StarBeam tries to teach him he doesn’t have to destroy and cheat to win.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x8
episodes_data.description: Everyone in Somerset wants to see the lunar eclipse, but Miserable Marla and her gloomy clouds are trying to block the view. Can StarBeam save the day?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 3x9
episodes_data.description: Zoey volunteers to watch Ms. Winkleman’s precious pup, Rex, while she’s away. But prankster Tricksy plays a switch-a-roo that only StarBeam can save!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x1
episodes_data.description: Tricksy's up to her old pranks and turns Gramps into a snail. Time for StarBeam and Boost to beat the playful pixie at her own game and get Gramps back!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x2
episodes_data.description: Murp is back on Earth and on the run from something mysterious. Can StarBeam, Boost and Kipper find out what their little pal is running away from?

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x3
episodes_data.description: Cosmic Crusher makes a mess of clean-up day even though he thinks he’s helping. Now it's up to StarBeam to convince him not to trash the whole town.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x4
episodes_data.description: Gramps and Henry try to find a cure for Zoey’s nonstop hiccups since they're getting in her way — especially when it's StarBeam's time to shine!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x5
episodes_data.description: Cue the marching music, it’s time for the annual Summersette Spectacular Parade! But StarBeam will have to keep Tricksy from ruining everyone’s fun.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x6
episodes_data.description: StarBeam swoops in when pesky pirate Fishbeard steals Boost’s new freeze spray to keep everyone frozen in place while he loots the town.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x7
episodes_data.description: A rare bird on Lava Lava Island wants Kipper as a forever friend and won’t let him go. Rescuing her feathery pal won’t be easy, but StarBeam can do it!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x8
episodes_data.description: Zoey’s band is playing an adoption concert at the animal shelter, but Tricksy has switched all the instrument sounds. Only StarBeam can save the show!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x9
episodes_data.description: StarBeam superfan Stella gets a tour of the secret Beam Control headquarters, where Boost keeps all the gadgets that help StarBeam beat the baddies.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x10
episodes_data.description: If there's lightning, it's probably Miserable Marla! She meets Stella, and the two have some fun with the different kinds of weather Marla brings.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x11
episodes_data.description: Stella spends a day on board Fishbeard's smelly pirate ship. But she causes more mischief than even he can handle!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x12
episodes_data.description: The joke's on Tricksy when Stella and Greta end up turning the tables and pulling a prank on the always-annoying pixie.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x13
episodes_data.description: StarBeam's superhero suit is full of star power, so Stella can't help showing off her StarBeam outfit to all of her fellow fans.

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x14
episodes_data.description: Ever wonder what it's like to see Summersette from a bird's-eye view? Stella straps a camera to StarBeam's pal Kipper to find out!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x15
episodes_data.description: StarBeam's super strength, super speed and super bubble beams run in her family. Stella learns more about StarBeam's mom, WonderBeam!

episodes_data.title: StarBeam 4x16
episodes_data.description: When the world needs saving, it's StarBeam's time to shine. This little hero's all heart — and she's unstoppable! A short-form music video.
